message.content:
(1) **Yes.** The bold upright (700, 11.5px) questions are clearly legible as run-in labels and establish a clean hierarchy: they anchor the section without competing with the larger, lighter serif answers (the hero content). The lack of italic eliminates the cramped feeling, making the long question strings easier to scan.

(2) **Better than expected.** Compared to the hypothetical quiet-italic version, this feels more structured and “editorial” rather than like loose marginalia. The bold weight gives the questions just enough presence to be useful signposts without stealing focus from the answers.

(3) **KEEP** — the bold upright is significantly more readable for dense trading-plan text while preserving the answer-as-hero visual priority.
